cframe: Where it is and how it is turned, relative to its parent.
visible: Off: it is not drawn, and queries skip it too.
pivot: The point it turns about, as an offset from its centre. A door turns at its hinge this way.
alwaysRelevant: Every player receives it whatever the distance. Off: players only get what is near them.
locked: On: clicking, box and lasso selection in the viewport skip this part. It can still be picked in the Explorer.
owner: The player that simulates its physics. Empty means the server.
ambient: The light every face gets inside the viewport, whatever way it points.
lightColor: The colour of the viewport's one directional light.
lightDirection: Which way the viewport's light shines, as a direction.
updateRate: Times per second the viewport draws its 3D again. 0 draws every frame.
resolutionScale: Below 1 the viewport draws fewer pixels and looks blocky, above 1 it is sharper and costs more.
RemoteFunction.timeout: Seconds an invoke waits for its answer before it fails. 0 waits forever.
accepts: What a message may carry, in order: "string", "number, vec3?"... Empty means no arguments; anything else sent is refused.
Part.shape: Block, ball, cylinder, wedge or corner wedge. A ball is as wide as the smallest side, a cylinder lies along X, and a wedge slopes from its top back edge down to its front.
Part.color: The colour it is drawn with.
anchored: On: physics never moves it, it stays exactly where it is placed. Off: it falls, gets pushed and rolls once the place plays.
collides: Off: bodies pass straight through it. A trigger pad is Collides off, Transparency 1, Can Touch on.
canQuery: Off: raycasts and spatial queries skip it.
canTouch: Off: it never fires touched or touchEnded.
collisionGroup: The collision group it belongs to. CollisionGroup instances say which groups pass through each other.
meshId: The model drawn in place of the box, a glTF, bbmodel or ammesh file.
animation: The clip of the model that plays.
animationSpeed: How fast the clip plays, 1 is normal speed.
animationLooped: On: the clip starts over when it ends.
LightSource.enabled: Off: the light gives no light.
temperature: A colour temperature in kelvin that tints the light. 0 keeps the colour as is.
range: How far the light reaches, in blocks.
falloff: How the light fades with distance.
falloffExponent: How sharply it fades for the exponent falloff.
shadows: On: things between the light and a surface block the light.
shadowStrength: How dark its shadows are, 0 to 1.
godrays: How strong the visible light shafts are.
innerAngle: The angle in degrees of the fully lit centre of the cone.
outerAngle: The angle in degrees where the cone fades to nothing.
soundId: The sound file or sound event to play.
Sound.pitch: How fast it plays, which carries its pitch with it. 1 is normal speed.
Sound.paused: On: it holds where it is until resume.
Sound.timePosition: How far into the sound it is, in seconds. Writing it jumps there.
Sound.timeLength: How long the whole sound is, in seconds, once it has loaded.
Sound.isLoaded: Its file is decoded and ready to play.
Sound.playbackLoudness: How loud it is playing right now, 0 to 1000. Worked out on each player's own machine.
SoundEffect.enabled: Off: the sound skips this effect.
SoundEffect.priority: Effects run from the lowest priority to the highest. Equal ones keep the order they sit in.
ReverbSoundEffect.decayTime: Seconds the tail takes to fade away.
ReverbSoundEffect.density: How thick the reflections are. Lower makes a smaller, boxier room.
ReverbSoundEffect.diffusion: How much the reflections smear into each other.
ReverbSoundEffect.dryLevel: How loud the untouched sound stays, in decibels.
ReverbSoundEffect.wetLevel: How loud the reverb is, in decibels.
EqualizerSoundEffect.lowGain: Decibels added to everything below the mid range.
EqualizerSoundEffect.midGain: Decibels added inside the mid range.
EqualizerSoundEffect.highGain: Decibels added to everything above the mid range.
EqualizerSoundEffect.midLow: Where the mid range starts, in hertz.
EqualizerSoundEffect.midHigh: Where the mid range ends, in hertz.
DistortionSoundEffect.level: How hard the sound is driven into clipping.
EchoSoundEffect.delay: Seconds between one repeat and the next.
EchoSoundEffect.feedback: How much of each repeat is fed back in. Near 1 it goes on for a long time.
EchoSoundEffect.dryLevel: How loud the untouched sound stays, in decibels.
EchoSoundEffect.wetLevel: How loud the repeats are, in decibels.
PitchShiftSoundEffect.octave: Multiplies the pitch without changing the speed. 2 is an octave up, 0.5 an octave down.
CompressorSoundEffect.threshold: The level in decibels above which the sound is held back.
CompressorSoundEffect.ratio: How much of what goes over the threshold is let through. 4 means a quarter.
CompressorSoundEffect.attack: Seconds it takes to clamp down once the sound goes over.
CompressorSoundEffect.release: Seconds it takes to let go once the sound falls back.
CompressorSoundEffect.makeupGain: Decibels added back after the squeeze.
ChorusSoundEffect.depth: How far the copy drifts in time.
ChorusSoundEffect.mix: How much of the drifting copy is heard against the original.
ChorusSoundEffect.rate: How many times a second the copy drifts back and forth.
FlangeSoundEffect.depth: How far the copy sweeps in time.
FlangeSoundEffect.mix: How much of the sweeping copy is heard against the original.
FlangeSoundEffect.rate: How many times a second the sweep goes back and forth.
TremoloSoundEffect.depth: How far the volume drops at the bottom of the wobble.
TremoloSoundEffect.duty: How much of each wobble is spent coming up rather than going down.
pitch: 1 is normal, higher plays faster and higher.
looped: On: it starts over when it ends.
bus: The mixer bus the sound goes through.
minDistance: Closer than this it plays at full volume.
maxDistance: Further than this it is silent.
rollOff: How the volume drops between the two distances.
fadeIn: Seconds it takes to reach full volume when it starts.
stream: On: it streams from disk instead of loading whole, for long music.
Zone.size: Its dimensions. A sphere uses x as its diameter, a cylinder x as diameter and y as height.
trackPlayers: On: bodies players wear count as inside.
trackTag: Anything with this tag counts as inside.
trackClass: Anything of this class counts as inside.
cooldown: Seconds before the same thing can enter or leave again.
Zone.priority: Where zones overlap, the higher one wins.
textChannel: Players inside join this chat channel.
Zone.soundId: A sound players hear while inside.
Zone.volume: How loud the zone sound is.
mode: How the camera follows: scripted, first person or third person.
fov: Field of view in degrees. 0 keeps the player's own.
distance: How far behind the subject a third person camera sits.
offset: Shifts the camera from its subject.
subject: What the camera follows.
CameraPath.duration: Seconds from the first point to the last when played.
CameraPath.easing: How progress speeds up and slows down along the path.
CameraPath.direction: Which end of the path the easing applies to.
CameraPath.looped: Starts again from the beginning instead of finishing.
CameraPath.closed: Joins the last point back to the first, for orbits.
CameraPath.faceAlong: Looks along the path instead of turning between the points' own rotations.
CameraPath.lookAt: Keeps looking at this instance the whole way. Wins over faceAlong.
teamColor: The team's colour. Spawn locations with the same colour only spawn this team.
autoAssignable: New players join the smallest team that has this on.
SpawnLocation.neutral: Anyone can spawn here. Off: only the team whose colour matches teamColor.
allowTeamChangeOnTouch: Standing on it moves the player to the team of its colour.
Character.team: The team of the player wearing this body.
Leaderstats.owner: The player whose scores these are. The engine fills it in when they join.
Tool.enabled: Off: clicking with the tool does nothing.
requiresHandle: The tool can only be equipped while it holds a part named Handle. A Handle is held in the right hand either way.
canBeDropped: Pressing the drop key leaves the tool in the world, where walking into its Handle picks it up.
manualActivationOnly: Clicking does not activate the tool, only tool:activate() does.
Tool.item: The Minecraft item shown in the hotbar and in the hand, like minecraft:iron_sword. A stick when empty.
toolTip: The name shown in the hotbar. The tool's name when empty.
Tool.grip: Where the hand holds the Handle, in the Handle's own space.
animationId: A res:// path to a .anim file. A KeyframeSequence inside the Animation is used instead when there is one.
AnimationTrack.animation: The Animation or KeyframeSequence this track plays.
AnimationTrack.speed: How fast the track plays. 1 is normal, negative plays backwards.
AnimationTrack.looped: Starts over at the end. The animation's own looped setting also loops it.
fadeTime: Seconds the track takes to blend in when played and out when stopped.
timePosition: Where the track is, in seconds. Not shared between the server and clients.
AnimationTrack.length: How long the animation is, in seconds.
KeyframeSequence.looped: Tracks playing this sequence start over at the end.
KeyframeSequence.priority: When tracks move the same joint, the highest priority wins.
Keyframe.time: When this keyframe is reached, in seconds from the start.
Pose.cframe: Where the joint named like this pose sits at this keyframe, relative to its rest.
Pose.easing: How the joint moves from this keyframe to the next one.
Pose.weight: How much of this pose is blended in, 0 to 1.
KeyframeMarker.value: Handed to getMarkerReachedSignal when the track passes this keyframe.
moveDirection: Which way the body is moving, flat and of length 1, or zero when still.
floorMaterial: The block under the feet, like minecraft:grass_block, or air.
sit: Sits the body. It can not walk, and jumping stands it up.
platformStand: Takes away walking and jumping, the body only moves when pushed.
autoRotate: Turns a body without a player to face where it walks.
healthRegen: Health gained each second while alive and hurt.
density: How heavy the part is for its size. Mass is density times volume.
friction: How much it grips what it slides on. 0 is ice.
elasticity: How much it bounces. 0 lands dead, 1 bounces back as high.
massless: Weighs nothing, so welding it to something does not make that heavier.
Part.velocity: How fast an unanchored part moves, in metres per second. Set it with setVelocity.
angularVelocity: How fast an unanchored part spins, in radians per second on each axis.
primaryPart: The part pivotTo and getPivot use, so the model moves about it.
Model.scale: The model's current scale. Change it with scaleTo, which also grows every part inside.
part1: The second part held together. It keeps its offset from part0 at the moment the weld starts.
attachment0: Where the constraint holds the first part. A hinge turns about this attachment's red X axis.
attachment1: Where the constraint holds the second part.
active: On while the constraint is really holding its parts. Off when a part is missing or both are anchored.
collideConnected: Lets the two connected parts still collide with each other.
actuatorType: None swings freely, motor spins at a speed, servo moves to a target.
HingeConstraint.angularVelocity: Motor speed in radians per second.
motorMaxTorque: How hard the motor may push.
angularSpeed: The fastest a servo turns, in radians per second.
servoMaxTorque: How hard the servo may push.
limitsEnabled: Stops the movement between the lower and upper values.
currentAngle: The angle the hinge is at now, in degrees.
PrismaticConstraint.velocity: Motor speed along the attachment's X axis, in metres per second.
targetPosition: Servo target along the axis, in metres.
currentPosition: How far along the axis it is now, in metres.
RopeConstraint.length: The rope is slack below this distance and taut at it.
freeLength: The length the spring rests at.
Constraint.color: The colour it is drawn in when visible is on.
RopeConstraint.thickness: How thick the rope is drawn, in metres.
winchEnabled: Reels the rope's length toward winchTarget.
winchTarget: The length the winch reels the rope to.
winchSpeed: The fastest the winch changes the length, in metres per second.
winchForce: The heaviest pull the winch can still reel in against.
winchResponsiveness: How quickly the winch reaches its speed. Lower eases in and out.
RopeConstraint.currentDistance: How far apart the two ends are now.
RodConstraint.length: The distance the rod holds its two ends at.
RodConstraint.thickness: How thick the rod is drawn, in metres.
RodConstraint.currentDistance: How far apart the two ends are now.
coils: How many turns the spring is drawn with.
SpringConstraint.radius: How wide the drawn coil is, in metres.
SpringConstraint.thickness: How thick the drawn wire is, in metres.
stiffness: How hard the spring pulls back, in newtons per metre.
damping: How quickly the spring stops bouncing.
Seat.disabled: On: nobody sits down on it, and whoever is on it stands up.
Seat.occupant: The humanoid sitting on it, or nothing. The engine fills this in.
VehicleSeat.maxSpeed: How fast the vehicle a script drives from this seat should go, in blocks a second.
VehicleSeat.torque: How hard the motors a script drives from this seat should push.
VehicleSeat.turnSpeed: How fast the vehicle a script drives from this seat should turn.
VehicleSeat.throttle: -1 back, 0 still, 1 forward, from the player sitting here.
VehicleSeat.steer: -1 left, 0 straight, 1 right, from the player sitting here.
SpawnLocation.enabled: Players can arrive here. With several enabled, each player picks one at random.
ViewportFrame.camera: The Camera the viewport looks through. Empty uses the first Camera inside it.
ViewportFrame.imageColor: Tints the drawn 3D, white leaves it as it is.
ViewportFrame.imageTransparency: 0 shows the drawn 3D fully, 1 hides it.
ClickDetector.maxActivationDistance: How far from its part, in blocks, a player can still hover and click it.
ClickDetector.cursorIcon: The cursor shown while a free pointer is over it: arrow, hand, text, crosshair, a res:// image. Empty shows a hand.
ParticleEmitter.enabled: Off: no new particles, the ones already out finish their life. emit still works.
ParticleEmitter.texture: The image each particle shows. An image in the place, a Minecraft particle name such as flame or glint, or empty for a soft dot.
Beam.enabled: Off: the beam is not drawn.
Trail.enabled: Off: the trail lays no new points and what is left fades away.
Highlight.enabled: Off: the highlight is not drawn.
Fire.enabled: Off: no new flames, the ones out burn away.
Smoke.enabled: Off: no new smoke, the puffs out drift away.
lifetimeMin: The shortest a particle lives, in seconds.
lifetimeMax: The longest a particle lives, in seconds. Each picks a lifetime between the two.
speedMin: The slowest a particle leaves at, in metres per second.
speedMax: The fastest a particle leaves at. Each picks a speed between the two.
spreadAngle: How far in degrees a particle may stray from the emission direction. 180 sends them every way.
emissionDirection: Which face of the part particles leave from. On an attachment it is the attachment's own axes.
shapeStyle: Volume: particles start anywhere inside the part. Surface: only on its faces.
acceleration: A constant pull on every particle in world space, in metres per second squared. Gravity is 0, -9.8, 0.
drag: How quickly particles slow down: they lose half their speed every 1/drag seconds.
rotationMin: The lowest starting angle of a particle, in degrees.
rotationMax: The highest starting angle of a particle, in degrees.
rotSpeedMin: The slowest a particle spins, in degrees per second.
rotSpeedMax: The fastest a particle spins, in degrees per second.
ParticleEmitter.sizeStart: How wide a particle is when it is born, in metres.
ParticleEmitter.sizeEnd: How wide a particle is when it dies. It grows or shrinks in between.
transparencyStart: Transparency at the start, 0 solid, 1 invisible. It fades towards the end value.
transparencyEnd: Transparency at the end, 0 solid, 1 invisible.
colorStart: The colour at the start. It blends towards the end colour.
ParticleEmitter.brightness: Multiplies the colour. Above 1 glows brighter.
Beam.brightness: Multiplies the colour. Above 1 glows brighter.
Trail.brightness: Multiplies the colour. Above 1 glows brighter.
lightEmission: 0 blends normally, 1 adds its light to what is behind it like fire or a laser.
lightInfluence: 0 ignores the world's light and is always fully bright, 1 darkens in shadow and at night like a block.
orientation: Facing camera turns every particle to the camera. Velocity parallel lines it up with where it is going.
lockedToPart: On: particles move with the part after they are emitted. Off: they are left behind in the world.
timeScale: How fast the effect plays, 1 is normal, 0 freezes it.
emitted: How many particles the server asked for with emit. Raising it emits the difference on every client.
Beam.attachment0: The attachment the beam starts at.
Beam.attachment1: The attachment the beam ends at.
Trail.attachment0: One edge of the trail. The trail spans the gap between the two attachments.
Trail.attachment1: The other edge of the trail.
Beam.texture: The image drawn along it. Empty is a plain colour.
Trail.texture: The image drawn along it. Empty is a plain colour.
textureLength: Stretch: how many times the image repeats along it. Wrap and static: metres per repeat.
textureSpeed: How many image lengths per second the image scrolls along the beam.
Beam.textureMode: Stretch fits the image to the whole beam. Wrap repeats it every texture length and scrolls it with texture speed. Static repeats it the same way but holds it still from attachment 0.
Trail.textureMode: Stretch fits the image to the whole trail. Wrap repeats it by distance and keeps it still against the attachments. Static repeats it by distance and leaves each repeat where it was laid in the world.
width0: How wide the beam is at attachment 0, in metres.
width1: How wide the beam is at attachment 1, in metres.
curveSize0: How far the curve bows out of attachment 0 along its X axis.
curveSize1: How far the curve bows into attachment 1 along its X axis.
segments: How many straight pieces the curve is drawn with.
faceCamera: On: it always turns its flat side to the camera. Off: it lies flat along the attachments' up axis.
Trail.lifetime: Seconds a piece of the trail lasts before it is gone.
Trail.minLength: The attachments must move at least this far before the trail lays a new point.
Trail.maxLength: The longest the trail can get, in metres. 0 is no limit.
widthScaleStart: Scales the width between the two attachments where the trail is new.
widthScaleEnd: Scales the width where the trail is about to disappear.
clears: How many times the server called clear. Raising it wipes the trail on every client.
adornee: What it shows on. Empty uses its parent.
fillColor: The colour laid over the inside.
fillTransparency: 0 covers the inside fully, 1 leaves it as it is.
outlineColor: The colour of the line around it.
outlineTransparency: 0 draws the line fully, 1 hides it.
depthMode: Always on top shows it through walls. Occluded hides what is behind something.
Decal.texture: The image drawn on the face.
Decal.face: Which face of the parent part it is drawn on.
Decal.color: Tints the image, white leaves it as it is.
zIndex: Higher draws over lower when several share a face.
studsPerTileU: Metres one copy of the image covers across the face.
studsPerTileV: Metres one copy of the image covers down the face.
offsetStudsU: Slides the image across the face, in metres.
offsetStudsV: Slides the image down the face, in metres.
Fire.size: How big the flames are, in metres.
Fire.color: The colour of the flames where they start.
secondaryColor: The colour the flames fade to.
Smoke.size: How big each puff is, in metres.
opacity: How thick the smoke is, 0 invisible, 1 solid.
riseVelocity: How fast the smoke rises, in metres per second. Negative sinks.
SelectionBox.visible: Off: the box is not drawn.
SelectionSphere.visible: Off: the sphere is not drawn.
SelectionBox.transparency: 0 draws the edges fully, 1 hides them.
SelectionSphere.transparency: 0 draws the rings fully, 1 hides them.
surfaceTransparency: 0 fills the faces fully, 1 leaves them empty.
lineThickness: How thick the edges are, in metres.
GuiObject.layoutOrder: Where it goes in a UIListLayout or UIGridLayout sorted by layout order. Lower comes first.
GuiObject.automaticSize: Grows along x, y or both to fit its text or its children. It never shrinks below its size.
GuiObject.absolutePosition: Where its top left corner ended up, in pixels, once laid out.
GuiObject.absoluteSize: How big it ended up, in pixels, once laid out and scaled.
GuiObject.cornerRadius: Rounds its corners, in pixels. A UICorner inside it wins.
TextLabel.textBounds: The size its text takes, in pixels.
TextBox.placeholderText: Shown in placeholder colour while the box is empty.
TextBox.clearTextOnFocus: Empties the box when it is clicked into or focused.
TextBox.multiLine: Enter starts a new line instead of finishing.
TextBox.textEditable: Off: the text can still be selected and copied, not changed.
TextBox.cursorPosition: Where the caret is, counting from 1. -1 while the box is not focused.
TextBox.selectionStart: The other end of the selection, counting from 1. -1 when nothing is selected.
ImageButton.hoverImage: Shown instead of image while the pointer is over it.
ImageButton.pressedImage: Shown instead of image while it is held down.
ScrollingFrame.canvasSize: How big the scrollable area is. Scale is a fraction of the frame.
ScrollingFrame.automaticCanvasSize: Grows the canvas along x, y or both to fit what is inside.
ScrollingFrame.canvasPosition: How far it is scrolled, in pixels, x and y.
ScrollingFrame.scrollBarThickness: Width of the scroll bars in pixels. 0 hides them.
ScrollingFrame.scrollingDirection: Which ways the wheel and dragging scroll.
ScrollingFrame.scrollingEnabled: Off: the wheel and dragging do nothing, scripts can still move canvasPosition.
CanvasGroup.groupTransparency: Fades the frame and everything inside it as one picture.
CanvasGroup.groupColor: Tints the frame and everything inside it.
UILayout.fillDirection: Which way the siblings are placed one after another.
UILayout.sortOrder: Sorts the siblings by layout order or by name.
UIListLayout.padding: The gap between siblings. x is used across, y down.
UIListLayout.wraps: Starts a new row or column when the next sibling would not fit.
UIGridLayout.cellSize: The size every sibling is given.
UIGridLayout.startCorner: The corner the first cell goes in.
UIGridLayout.fillDirectionMaxCells: Most cells in a row or column. 0 fits as many as there is room for.
UIPadding.paddingLeft: Space kept free inside the left edge. Uses x.
UIPadding.paddingRight: Space kept free inside the right edge. Uses x.
UIPadding.paddingTop: Space kept free inside the top edge. Uses y.
UIPadding.paddingBottom: Space kept free inside the bottom edge. Uses y.
UIAspectRatioConstraint.aspectType: Fit inside its size, or follow the dominant axis.
UISizeConstraint.minSize: The smallest it can be, in pixels, x and y.
UISizeConstraint.maxSize: The biggest it can be, in pixels, x and y. 0 does not limit.
UIScale.scale: Draws its parent and everything inside it this many times bigger.
UIStroke.applyStrokeMode: Contextual outlines the text of a label, border outlines the frame.
UIStroke.thickness: Width of the outline in pixels.
UIGradient.keypoints: More than two colours: "time r g b transparency" entries split by commas. Wins over the start and end values.
UIGradient.rotation: Turns the gradient, in degrees. 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom.
UIGradient.offset: Slides the gradient, as a fraction of the size, x and y.
Lighting.clockTime: The time of day in hours, 0 to 24. It drives the game's own clock, so the sun, the sky and the block light all follow it.
Lighting.timeScale: How fast the day runs. 0 freezes it, 1 is a twenty minute day, 2 runs it twice as fast.
geographicLatitude: How far north the place sits, in degrees. It tilts the sun's path: 0 sends it straight overhead at noon, 90 keeps it at the horizon.
Lighting.brightness: How strong the sunlight is. 2 is the light the game gives on its own, higher washes the world out.
Lighting.ambient: The least light anything gets, even indoors and at night. Black leaves caves dark.
outdoorAmbient: Tints the light the sky gives. Grey (0.5) leaves it as the game has it.
exposureCompensation: Brightens or darkens the whole picture in stops. 1 is twice as bright, -1 half.
shadowSoftness: How blurry the edges of the sun's shadows are.
globalShadows: On: the sun casts shadows. A ShadowQuality effect has to be in the place for the shadow pass to run at all.
environmentDiffuseScale: How much of the surroundings' light reaches meshes. 0 leaves them lit by the sun alone.
environmentSpecularScale: How much the surroundings show up in the shine on meshes.
Lighting.rain: How hard it rains, 0 to 1. A Lighting in the world takes the weather over, so the game's own cycle no longer starts or stops rain.
Lighting.thunder: How dark and stormy it is, 0 to 1. Rain has to be on for it to show.
skyboxBk: The image for the back of the sky, facing south. Filling any face puts the whole box in place of the game's sky.
skyboxDn: The image for the bottom of the sky.
skyboxFt: The image for the front of the sky, facing north.
skyboxLf: The image for the left of the sky, facing west.
skyboxRt: The image for the right of the sky, facing east.
skyboxUp: The image for the top of the sky.
sunTextureId: An image drawn in place of the sun. Empty keeps the game's own sun.
moonTextureId: An image drawn in place of the moon. Empty keeps the game's own moon and its phases.
sunAngularSize: How wide the sun looks, in degrees. The game's own sun is about 33.
moonAngularSize: How wide the moon looks, in degrees. The game's own moon is about 23.
starCount: How many stars come out at night, up to 3000, which is every star the game has.
celestialBodiesShown: Off: no sun, no moon and no stars.
skyboxOrientation: Turns the box of images, in degrees. The sun and the moon keep following the clock.
Atmosphere.density: How thick the air is, 0 to 1. It pulls the game's distance fog in: 0 leaves the view open to the render distance, 1 closes it to a few blocks. A FogEffect is a separate screen pass and draws on top of this.
Atmosphere.offset: Pushes the near edge of the fog out, -1 to 1. At 1 the fog only starts just before it is thickest.
Atmosphere.color: The colour of the air near the camera. Haze decides how much of it is used.
decay: The colour the air falls back to away from the sun. With no haze the fog takes this colour alone.
glare: How much the air lights up when the sun is ahead, 0 to 10.
haze: How far the air reaches into the sky, 0 to 10. It also trades the decay colour for the atmosphere's own colour.
cover: How much sky the clouds take, 0 to 1. The game's clouds keep their shape, so less cover thins them instead of opening holes.
Clouds.density: How solid the clouds look, 0 to 1.
Clouds.color: The colour the clouds are tinted.
Explosion.position: Where it goes off, in world coordinates.
blastRadius: How far it reaches, in blocks. Nothing outside is touched.
blastPressure: How hard it throws things. 500000 sends a part at the centre away at 20 blocks a second.
destroyJointRadiusPercent: The share of the radius that kills. Anything with a humanoid closer in than this dies.
explosionType: Craters breaks the blocks it reaches, no craters leaves them alone.
Explosion.visible: On: players see the blast and hear it.
UICorner.cornerRadius: Rounds the corners. Scale is a fraction of the shorter side, 0.5 makes a pill.
